caption: The drawing depicts a single, tall, cylindrical pitcher with a domed lid and a decorative finial on top. The pitcher has a large, curved handle with an ornate, scrolling design and a spout that curves outward from the upper left side. The entire object is rendered in grayscale pencil or ink on a light beige background, giving it a metallic appearance due to the shading and highlights. The pitcher sits within a rectangular frame centered on the page. There are no other objects or elements in the drawing, and the artist’s signature is located in the lower right corner inside the frame.
title: Pewter Flagon
